lines.en: I'd like to toast Ross and Emily.
Of course, my big toast will be tomorrow at the wedding,
so this is kind of my little toast, or Melba toast, if you will.
I've known Ross for a long time.
In fact, I knew him when he was going out with his first girlfriend.
And I thought things were really going to work out for him
until the day he overinflated her.
I'm sure we're all very excited
that Ross and Emily are getting married at Montgomery Hall.
I mean, to thank my friend getting married in Monty Hall.
Oh, come on. Monty Hall? Let's make a deal?
All right, forget it. Congratulations, Ross and Emily.
Hey, best man number two, Joey Tribbiani.
Now, I'm not good with the jokes like Chandler here, but...
